h5Dwarf3rdBattleRager.description:
Brawlers, Berserkers and Battleragers are the level 4 units of the Heroes V Fortress (merged into Bulwark). All of them have {Mind Control Immunity} (immune to Mind magic). Berserkers also have {Berserker Rage} (converts all Defense into Attack and attacks the nearest unit without retaliation). Battleragers also have {Giant Slayer} (+4 Attack and +4 Defense when fighting large creatures), {Shield Bash} (melee attacks have a chance to stun the target, which cannot retaliate and has its ATB reset to 0) and {Battle Rage} (+5 Attack and +20% Speed for 2 rounds after taking damage).

These dwarven killing machines fear neither hydras, dragons nor any other terrifying creature. They merely laugh off their wounds and throw themselves into even fiercer attacks.

See also {Brawler}, {Berserker}.

h5Dwarf3rdFlameKeeper.description:
Rune Priests, Rune Patriarchs and Rune Keepers are the level 5 units of the Heroes V Fortress (merged into Bulwark). All of them can shoot and cast {Deflect Missile} (2 times per battle, 15 mana), and have {Mark of Fire} (a chance to make the target take double damage from Fire magic for 2 rounds). Rune Priests have {50% Fire Proof} (-50% Fire magic damage). Rune Patriarchs also have {Immune to Fire} (immune to Fire magic) and {Cross Shot} (the shot hits the target and the ring of hexes around it, friend and foe alike). Rune Keepers also have {Immune to Fire} (immune to Fire magic).

Killing a Rune Keeper is no simple task, and without armor that resists Fire magic it is downright impossible. Rune Keepers have no fear of fire themselves: the Marks of Fire they carve make enemies suffer double in the flames, and the Fireball Volleys they command can turn an entire enemy line into a sea of fire.

See also {Rune Priest}, {Rune Patriarch}.

h5Dwarf3rdHarpooner.description:
Spearwielders, Skirmishers and Harpooners are the level 2 units of the Heroes V Fortress (merged into Bulwark). All of them can shoot. Spearwielders have {Wound} (a chance to give the target -40% Speed for 2 rounds). Skirmishers also have {No Melee Penalty} and {Wound} (a chance to give the target -40% Speed for 2 rounds). Harpooners are also immune to {Armor Break} and have {Armored} (unaffected by any spell or effect that lowers Defense) and {Harpoon Strike} (damages the enemy it hits and pulls it one hex closer).

Harpooners know their craft well, and in their hands the harpoon becomes extraordinarily powerful. Once struck by a harpoon, enemies risk being knocked down rank after rank, leaving them exposed to the dwarves' axes.

See also {Spearwielder}, {Skirmisher}.

h5Dwarf3rdLavaDragon.description:
Fire Dragons, Magma Dragons and Lava Dragons are the level 7 units of the Heroes V Fortress (merged into Bulwark). All of them are dragons and have {Elemental} (non-living, immune to Mind magic) and {Immune to Fire} (immune to Fire magic). Fire Dragons have {Fire Shield} (reflects 20% of melee damage back to the attacker) and {Fire Breath} (the attack also hits the unit behind the target). Magma Dragons also have {Fire Breath} (the attack also hits the unit behind the target) and {Magma Shield} (reflects 40% of melee damage back to the attacker). Lava Dragons also have {Liquid Flame} (leaves flames on the attacked spot for 2 rounds; units that step on them take 9 × the number of Lava Dragons in Fire damage).

Lava Dragons are born deep in the earth's core, in lakes of white-hot molten lava. These fire-breathing monsters can easily burn enemies to ashes and raise a wall of fire that keeps them burning.

See also {Fire Dragon}, {Magma Dragon}.

h5Dwarf3rdStoneDefender.description:
Defenders, Shieldguards and Mountain Guards are the level 1 units of the Heroes V Fortress (merged into Bulwark). All of them are immune to {Armor Break} and have {Enrage} (Attack increases when an allied stack is destroyed), {Large Shield} (half damage from ranged attacks) and {Armored} (unaffected by any spell or effect that lowers Defense). Shieldguards also have {Shield Wall} (-10% damage from an enemy melee attack for every hex the enemy moved, up to 90%). Mountain Guards also have {Hold Ground} (cannot be knocked back, pulled or displaced) and {Prepared Position} (+5 Defense while standing in its starting position).

Mountain Guards have granite-like defenses that can withstand the most savage enemy attacks. These legendary dwarf warriors wear armor as solid as fortress walls, which makes them a real headache for any foe. As long as they keep their footing, getting past this barrier is very hard.

See also {Defender}, {Shieldguard}.

h5Dwarf3rdThunderThane.description:
Thanes, Warlords and Thunder Thanes are the level 6 units of the Heroes V Fortress (merged into Bulwark). All of them can teleport. Thanes have {Stormstrike} (after attacking, lightning chains to adjacent enemies for the same damage). Warlords also have {Immune to Fire} (immune to Fire magic), {Flamewave} (melee attacks have a chance to raise a wave of fire; of the 5 rows behind the target, row N takes 1/N damage) and {Flamestrike} (the next attack deals 1.2 times damage and applies Mark of Fire). Thunder Thanes also have {Stormstrike} (after attacking, lightning chains to adjacent enemies for the same damage), {Lightning Immunity} (immune to Air magic) and {Storm Bolt} (a ranged Stormstrike that also chains, 1 time per battle, 2 times from experience level 6).

Their deadliest weapon is not the axe in their hands but the mysterious power hidden in their clenched fists. Thunder Thanes can unleash bolts of lightning to strike down their foes, leaving hapless enemies nowhere to hide.

See also {Thane}, {Warlord}.

h5Dwarf3rdWhiteBearRider.description:
Bear Riders, Blackbear Riders and Whitebear Riders are the level 3 units of the Heroes V Fortress (merged into Bulwark). All of them have {Enrage} (Attack increases when an allied stack is destroyed). Blackbear Riders are also immune to {Armor Break} and have {Armored} (unaffected by any spell or effect that lowers Defense) and {Paw Strike} (a chance to knock the target back 1 hex and reset its ATB to 0). Whitebear Riders also have {Bear Roar} (a chance to drive off the target and adjacent enemies in fear; on success, +1 Morale and +10% Hit Points).

The dwarves brought these huge white bears from the far north and specially trained them into war machines. Their sharp teeth, powerful claws and the stench they give off are a nightmare for anyone who dares stand in their way.

See also {Bear Rider}, {Blackbear Rider}.

Spearwielders are the trump card of the dwarven forces. Their powerful strikes and skill with double-bladed spears give them a chance to reduce the target's Speed and Initiative.

No army is complete without fast-moving cavalry, so the dwarves tamed ferocious bears. Although the bears move slowly, their great defensive strength makes up well for this shortcoming.

See also {Blackbear Rider}, {Whitebear Rider}.

Berserkers are much like Brawlers, but they wear gauntlets fitted with sharp blades. In battle, Berserkers can fall into a frenzy, sacrificing their defense to strike nearby creatures more effectively without suffering retaliation.

See also {Brawler}, {Battlerager}.

Bear Riders, Blackbear Riders and Whitebear Riders are the level 3 units of the Heroes V Fortress (merged into Bulwark). All of them have {Enrage} (Attack increases when an allied stack is destroyed). Blackbear Riders are also immune to {Armor Break} and have {Armored} (unaffected by any spell or effect that lowers Defense) and {Paw Strike} (a chance to knock the target back 1 hex and reset its ATB to 0). Blackbear Riders are the elite of the dwarven cavalry. These mighty black bears wear heavy armor and gain greater stamina through rigorous training. What is more, the black bears can fly into a rage and swipe at enemies with their sharp claws, knocking them off balance and lowering their Initiative.

See also {Bear Rider}, {Whitebear Rider}.

Brawlers, Berserkers and Battleragers are the level 4 units of the Heroes V Fortress (merged into Bulwark). All of them have {Mind Control Immunity} (immune to Mind magic). Berserkers also have {Berserker Rage} (converts all Defense into Attack and attacks the nearest unit without retaliation). Battleragers also have {Giant Slayer} (+4 Attack and +4 Defense when fighting large creatures), {Shield Bash} (melee attacks have a chance to stun the target, which cannot retaliate and has its ATB reset to 0) and {Battle Rage} (+5 Attack and +20% Speed for 2 rounds after taking damage).

Brawlers are masters of hand-to-hand combat who scorn weapons. They firmly believe that sturdy gauntlets and strong arms are enough to cripple an opponent. Thanks to their unshakable faith in their fighting skill, Brawlers ignore all magic that affects the mind.

See also {Berserker}, {Battlerager}.

Defenders are the most numerous troops of the dwarven Stone Halls and the steadfast backbone of the dwarven army. Defenders wear heavy armor and always hold their ground, even against powerful enemies.

See also {Shieldguard}, {Mountain Guard}.

Fire Dragons are the children of Arkath, the Dragon of Fire; they are the masters of flame and the guardians of the dwarves. Like Black Dragons, Fire Dragons can breathe fire on their enemies. Any unit that attacks a Fire Dragon in melee is burned by its scorching skin. Naturally, Fire Dragons are immune to all Fire magic.

See also {Magma Dragon}, {Lava Dragon}.

The dwarves believe that golden eyes at birth are the mark of Arkath, the Dragon of Fire, and such children are recruited into the dwarves' special corps of battle mages: the Rune Priests. Rune Priests can attack enemies from a distance, and under Arkath's protection Fire magic deals them only half damage. Rune Priests can place the Mark of Fire to increase the fire damage the target takes.

See also {Rune Patriarch}, {Rune Keeper}.

Shieldguards are battle-hardened warriors whose sacred duty is to protect their allies. With their powerful shields, Shieldguards effectively reduce the damage they take. In melee, the farther an enemy has moved, the less damage it can deal to them.

See also {Defender}, {Mountain Guard}.

h5DwarfThane.description:
Thanes, Warlords and Thunder Thanes are the level 6 units of the Heroes V Fortress (merged into Bulwark). All of them can teleport. Thanes have {Stormstrike} (after attacking, lightning chains to adjacent enemies for the same damage). Warlords also have {Immune to Fire} (immune to Fire magic), {Flamewave} (melee attacks have a chance to raise a wave of fire; of the 5 rows behind the target, row N takes 1/N damage) and {Flamestrike} (the next attack deals 1.2 times damage and applies Mark of Fire). Thanes are not only strong warriors but also seasoned mages. A Thane can teleport instantly in front of the enemy and swing his great axe to slaughter the enemy troops. His great axe can even release chain lightning as it strikes, hitting nearby enemies.

See also {Warlord}, {Thunder Thane}.

Warlords are Thanes who were transformed by sacrificing themselves in the hope of commanding the divine power of fire. In battle, Warlords can deliver powerful Fire strikes against a target and the units next to it.

See also {Thane}, {Thunder Thane}.
